newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fed T-note buying may be on behalf of MOF - traders.
newsitem.headline: Fed T-note buying may be on behalf of MOF - traders.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Reserve bought U.S. Treasuries in New York on Wednesday and the purchases could have been made on behalf of Japan's Ministry of Finance, traders in Tokyo said on Thursday.
"It was pretty clear the Fed bought Treasuries of durations of two, three, five and 10 years overnight and the buying could be for MOF," a senior bond trader said.
The Ministry of Finance manages external reserves worth $214.028 billion, the largest part of which is held in U.S. Treasury bills and notes.
MOF has a policy of not discussing its reserve management.
The overnight rally in the U.S. Treasury market, helped by the Fed buying, also invited relatively strong bids by Japanese in Tokyo and supported the market across the yield curve.

New York traders said central bank buying and a large purchase of securities in the middle of the yield curve gave the market a leg up on Wednesday. They said the Fed purchased Treasuries for the accounts of other central banks.
A Fed spokesman said on Wednesday that if the Fed was "doing any operations for a customer of ours, we would not comment".
